summary: Implemented the grid-sampled patch feature without running tests or repository code, and without committing. Changes: monai/data/utils.py (iter_patch yields (patch view, coordinates) pairs with coordinates computed from padding offsets; set_rnd skips double-underscore attributes); monai/data/grid_dataset.py (new PatchIter, reworked GridPatchDataset(dataset, patch_iter, transform, with_coordinates) using injected patch generator, ceil-based worker split, apply_transform with map_items=False, NotImplementedError for missing len; PatchDataset example uses float); monai/data/__init__.py exports PatchIter; docs/source/data.rst adds PatchIter autodoc; tests/test_grid_dataset.py adds TestGridPatchDataset with test_shape, test_loading_array, and an extra test_missing_length. Open items: tests are unverified (pinned values taken from spec, pytest needed to confirm); setUp and test_loading_array both call set_determinism(1234); get_valid_patch_size docstring lines 231-233 in utils.py exceed 120 chars but predate this change and were left untouched.
